faq.q1_question: Is the Career Interest Quiz really free?
faq.q1_answer: Yes, 100% free! You can take the 6-minute assessment, view your archetype analysis, and download the full personalised course report without paying anything.
faq.q2_question: Is my personal contact data safe?
faq.q2_answer: Absolutely. Your data is stored securely in your browser and used strictly to deliver your guidance report and provide genuine counselling support. We comply with Indian DPDP Act norms and never sell data to spam lists.
faq.q3_question: Will you push specific private colleges?
faq.q3_answer: No. Our assessment matches government, aided, private, and deemed colleges purely based on your stream, scores, and declared budget. We offer objective guidance, not sponsored college quotas.
faq.q4_answer: The assessment is structured around proven RIASEC career interest models adapted for 12th standard Indian curricula. It provides guidance, not a verdict, helping you shortlist 3-5 high-probability career paths.

testimonials.t3: The fee breakdown and college categories in the parent summary made it very easy for my dad to plan our budget for BCom with ACCA.
